segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I pulled up the order form. It's 24 platform seats, one analytics add-on, and the implementation package at $6,800 one-time. Annual comes to $41,760 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I have. Net 30, billed on signature, then renewal next year on March 1?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. The term runs March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. If legal gets it back by Friday, we can keep the discount as shown.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Quick thing though, the kickoff invite I got this morning says March 4 and 18 seats. We were aiming at March 11 and 24 seats, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, yeah, you're right. Sorry about that. I'll get that cleaned up today so the calendar and workspace match the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. I just don't want my ops lead planning around the wrong week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. For go-live on March 25, we'd want the admin names by March 8, and your file export by March 12. Does that still work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. I'll send the four admin contacts after this call. Procurement may ask for the insurance cert again, same as last time.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I'll attach that with the countersigned order form. Anything else blocking signature on your side?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, assuming the invoice shows the PO number, 77419, we're fine. Send it over and I'll route it.
